statement: There are real edge-length assignments for fan gluings of Desargues graphs whose number of real planar embeddings grows as 12^(n/3). Each further Desargues copy shares a fixed base triangle, adds three vertices, and multiplies the realization count by 12; reflection across the fixed base edge supplies an overall factor two. The journal gives this as a construction lower bound on the maximum, not an upper bound for all Laman graphs.

answer.text: Fan Desargues constructions give an exponential lower bound with base 12^(1/3)≈2.289 for maximum real planar embeddings.
